data.title: Complex Composite Figures Involving Circles and Semicircles
data.description: Engage in critical analysis of advanced geometric spaces by calculating the area and perimeter of complex composite figures that combine squares, circles, and semicircles in real-world architectural contexts.

challenges.narration: A half-circle window is shaped like this semicircle.
challenges.instruction: Find the area of this semicircle — half of a full circle.
challenges.hint: A semicircle is half a circle: area = ½ × π × r².

challenges.narration: A semicircular rug is shaped like this semicircle.
challenges.instruction: Find the perimeter of this semicircle — the curved part plus the straight diameter.
challenges.hint: Perimeter = half the circumference + the diameter = π × r + 2 × r.

challenges.narration: A circular pool in a square deck — a circle fits exactly inside the square.
challenges.instruction: A circle is inscribed in the square. Find the shaded area left over.
challenges.hint: Shaded = square area − circle area = s² − π × (s ÷ 2)². The circle's radius is half the side.

challenges.narration: A half-moon garden bed is shaped like this semicircle.
challenges.instruction: Find the area of this semicircle — half of a full circle.
challenges.hint: A semicircle is half a circle: area = ½ × π × r².
